description: The main window, the console windows, the pictures window, the aliases window and the I/O trace window: Tauri's core defaults (events included: the main window tells the consoles which sessions it closed), the page's zoom (Ctrl+plus/minus, Settings), a window's title (the console's, the pictures', the aliases' and the trace's), and what the page's own title bar does: drag the window, minimize, maximize, close; our own commands need no permission entry.
